clues.clue: Changi Airport, famous for its indoor waterfall, serves this city-state.
clues.explanation: Singapore Changi Airport is home to the Jewel's Rain Vortex, the world's tallest indoor waterfall.

clues.clue: Name the city shown in this picture.
clues.explanation: Istanbul's skyline is distinguished by landmarks such as Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque beside the Bosphorus.

clues.clue: Your boarding pass lists HND as the destination airport. Which city are you flying to?
clues.explanation: HND is the IATA airport code for Tokyo's Haneda Airport, located closer to central Tokyo than Narita.

clues.clue: Name the city shown in this picture.
clues.explanation: Edinburgh Castle sits on Castle Rock, a volcanic formation overlooking Scotland's capital.

clues.clue: Sameer, Aakash, and Sid are the three inseparable friends in which Bollywood film?
clues.explanation: Saif Ali Khan plays Sameer, Aamir Khan plays Aakash, and Akshaye Khanna plays Sid in the 2001 film Dil Chahta Hai.

clues.clue: Vinay Pathak, Ranvir Shorey, and Rajat Kapoor appeared together in which Bollywood film?
clues.explanation: The three actors appear in the 2007 comedy Bheja Fry: Vinay Pathak plays Bharat Bhushan, Rajat Kapoor plays Ranjeet Thadani, and Ranvir Shorey plays Asif Merchant.

clues.clue: This filmmaker directed Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham and My Name Is Khan.
clues.explanation: Karan Johar directed both family dramas and is also a prominent producer through Dharma Productions.

clues.clue: This familiar supporting actor is Manu Rishi Chadha. Name any Bollywood movie in which he appeared.
clues.answer: Accept any valid film—for example: Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!, Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan, Angrezi Mein Kehte Hain, Dasvi, or Raksha Bandhan.
clues.explanation: Manu Rishi Chadha is a character actor and dialogue writer known especially for Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!, for which he also wrote the dialogue.

clues.title: VISUAL LANDMARK REVEAL
clues.clue: This famous pink façade belongs to a landmark in which Indian city?
clues.explanation: Jaipur is known as the Pink City of India. Hawa Mahal's pink sandstone façade has 953 small windows called jharokhas.

interaction.alt: Pink façade with repeating historic windows

clues.title: THREE CLUES. ONE STATE.
clues.clue: Which Indian state connects all three images?
clues.explanation: Meghalaya is home to living root bridges, rain-soaked Cherrapunji, and the Khasi Hills. Its name means ‘abode of clouds.’

clues.title: INDIA FROM ABOVE
clues.clue: Can you identify this famous Indian landmark from its aerial view?
clues.explanation: This historic Tamil Nadu temple is known for its towering, intricately decorated gopurams and sprawling complex at the heart of Madurai.

interaction.alt: Aerial view of a colorful temple complex surrounded by dense city streets

clues.title: IDENTIFY THE MONUMENT
clues.clue: Which famous Indian monument does this iconic wheel belong to?
clues.explanation: The 13th-century Sun Temple in Odisha was designed as Surya's monumental stone chariot, complete with carved wheels.

interaction.alt: The carved stone wheel at an Indian temple

clues.title: CONNECT THE CLUES
clues.clue: What one Indian city connects all four clues?
clues.explanation: Gwalior connects its celebrated gharana, the legacy and tomb of Tansen, the Scindia dynasty, and the imposing Gwalior Fort.

clues.title: GUESS THE BABY ITEM
clues.clue: What baby item is this?
clues.explanation: A teether gives babies a safe surface to chew as their teeth begin coming through.

clues.title: BABY BY THE NUMBERS
clues.supportingLine: One baby. One year. A LOT of diaper changes.
clues.clue: Approximately how many diapers does an average baby use in their first year?
clues.explanation: Accept any answer from 2,500 through 3,000. Newborns may need around 8–12 diaper changes daily, with the frequency generally decreasing as they grow.

interaction.alt: A huge playful pile of diapers surrounding a question mark

clues.title: THROUGH A NEWBORN’S EYES
clues.clue: The world is still a blur, but at one close range, a newborn can see a caregiver’s face most clearly. Approximately how far away is that?
clues.explanation: Accept 8–12 inches or 1 foot. This close range roughly matches the distance between a feeding newborn and a caregiver’s face.

interaction.alt: A softly blurred caregiver seen from a newborn's point of view

clues.title: FIRST THINGS FIRST
clues.clue: A newborn’s very first poop has a special medical name. What is it called?
clues.explanation: Meconium is a newborn’s thick, dark, sticky first stool. Passing it is an important early sign that the digestive system is functioning, and hospital staff monitor for it during the first day or two after birth.

interaction.alt: A tasteful hospital nursery with a newborn bassinet

clues.title: TINY BUT MIGHTY
clues.clue: A newborn’s stomach is surprisingly tiny. On the first day of life, it is often compared in size to what fruit?
clues.explanation: A newborn’s stomach capacity is very small during the first days of life, which is one reason newborns typically feed in small amounts and very frequently.

interaction.alt: An elegant newborn silhouette with a tiny stomach illustration

clues.title: GUESS THE DISH
clues.clue: What famous dish is this?
clues.explanation: Shakshuka features eggs poached in a warmly spiced tomato and pepper sauce, traditionally served directly from the pan.

interaction.alt: Eggs poached in tomato and pepper sauce in a skillet

clues.title: FOOD PASSPORT
clues.clue: What famous dessert is this food passport describing?
clues.explanation: Baklava layers crisp phyllo pastry with nuts and sweet syrup or honey; pistachio versions are especially associated with Türkiye.

clues.title: LOST IN TRANSLATION
clues.clue: The name of which famous Chinese culinary tradition roughly translates to ‘touch the heart’?
clues.explanation: The Cantonese expression dim sum is commonly interpreted as ‘touch the heart,’ describing a tradition of many small dishes, often enjoyed with tea.

clues.title: ONE INGREDIENT CONNECTS THEM ALL
clues.clue: These three come from completely different culinary worlds, but one distinctive ingredient connects them all. What is it?
clues.explanation: Tamarind brings its distinctive sweet-sour depth to Pad Thai sauce, South Indian sambar, and the original flavor profile of Worcestershire sauce.

clues.title: FOOD MAP WITHOUT BORDERS
clues.clue: No borders. No flag. Just food. Which country does this culinary map represent?
clues.explanation: The silhouette combines Peninsular and East Malaysia with four iconic foods: nasi lemak, satay, laksa, and roti canai.
